name: What is the average cost of a bathroom refresh in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost of a bathroom refresh in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a bathroom refresh in the Bay Area varies widely based on material choices and the extent of the work. A basic refresh focusing on paint, new fixtures, and a vanity might range from $5,000 to $15,000. Projects involving tile replacement, updated plumbing fixtures, and custom elements could range from $15,000 to $30,000+. We provide transparent, itemized quotes after an initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for a bathroom refresh in the Bay Area can range from $5,000 for basic updates to over $30,000 for more extensive work, depending on materials and scope.
